roadmap_payload.problem: A consumer rollout declared package transport unavailable after one high-level write route failed even though an authorized low-level Git object route still worked.
roadmap_payload.fix: Reinforce carrier-neutral package transport with explicit fallback reconciliation: direct contents/file write -> low-level Git blob/tree transport (when authorized) -> exact package-tree verification before ref movement; suppress unchanged retries and preserve exact rollback.
roadmap_payload.invariant: Transport-channel failure is not package failure. Adoption advances only on exact canonical package-tree identity, and transport_unavailable is valid only after authorized carrier alternatives are exhausted.
